verification_basis: Every row below was re-derived by RUNNING the counterexample against this candidate tree (preflight/reconcile_findings.py); no row is closed on file inspection alone. Raw JSON: preflight/RECONCILIATION_FRESH_EVIDENCE.json

findings.what_closed_it: README now filters SHA256SUMS to the single downloaded asset and checks the row count; positive on the REAL published SHA256SUMS + REAL wheel bytes (recomputed digest == the published literal d6c3e295...), negative on a tampered byte and on zero rows under pipefail.

profiles.compute_profile refuses ['intent']*4 as a typed ProfileVeto before any escalation math, and refuses non-string / empty / unknown axis sets; the legal ladder (LITE / STANDARD / ASSURED / provider-off escalation) does not regress.
a trust_boundary tag with no risk evidence yields risk_assessment=NOT_ASSESSED and LOW_RISK_VERIFIED is never emitted - an axis count is not a risk score.

PI-PKG now types version/subject_id/schema_version/content_hash and the trace array shape; integer subject_id, integer version, scalar trace, null trace and a malformed trace item are each rejected, the legal record still validates clean.

findings.what_is_missing: README lines 107-118 still show '<your goal>', '<a locator that EXISTS>', '<path to an intent card>', '<path to the assembled bundle>'. The real copy-paste-able chain exists (examples/self-bootstrap/, driven through the CLI by subprocess with a raw transcript) but the README does not point at it.

findings.what_closed_it: a compact mount ZIP ships with README_MOUNT.md, SKILL.md, a short launch prompt, the S4 core / source-map / 8-skills-index references and a MANIFEST.sha256 that verifies (8/8) from real extracted bytes.
findings.deviation_disclosed: the reaudit names references/PIPD_PROFILE_SAFETY.md; the pack ships references/PIPD_PROFILE_AND_SAFETY.md with the same role. Renaming would invalidate the ZIP digest that already carries a verified receipt, so the name difference is disclosed instead of churned.

findings.what: R7 scoped PASS and R8 overall FAIL are both preserved verbatim; neither is upgraded.
no 57/57 all-green claim; DEL-018 subject mismatch stays recorded as a stale rolling row.

findings.what_is_missing: the .1/.2 same-basename/different-bytes hazard is not yet stated on the front page, and there is no PEP 440 guidance for the next distribution version.

findings.what_closed_it: docs/NORMATIVE_SOURCE_MAP.md plus examples/self-bootstrap/ with a real replay.

findings.what: no native-workspace Web UAT and no cross-OS run in this round; recorded as a gap, and the independent checker's own receipt is the only elevated evidence.

findings.real_counterexample: validate_record('ProfileBinding', ...) returns ZERO findings for axes="intent", axes=["intent",7], profile=7 and vetoes="none" - the record that carries the duplicate-axes decision is still an open object.
findings.user_impact: a Host branching on profile/axes/vetoes reads an unconstrained value; the machine contract does not actually constrain the field it is named after.
findings.smallest_scope: add type/items/enum to the five ProfileBinding contract fields only
findings.scope_justification: S4-CONTRACT-HARDEN-03's admitted WriteSet is 'the actually-affected schemas'; ProfileBinding is the schema F-S4R2-02 is about, so it is inside that set rather than a new work order.
